title: Preliminary results for the TJCE civil service exam are released
subtitle: Candidates can now check their objective and essay exam scores on the organizing institution's website.
excerpt: The Court of Justice of Ceará has released the preliminary results of the objective and essay exams for the 2026 civil service competition.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Court of Justice of Ceará has released the preliminary results for the objective and essay-writing exams of the civil service competition governed by the 2026 notice. The publication is being handled by Fundação Carlos Chagas, the organizing committee responsible for the selection process, which registered tens of thousands of applicants.

How to check the preliminary results

Participants can track the publication of the preliminary results for both the objective and essay exams directly through Fundação Carlos Chagas' channels. The assessments were administered in August, and candidates should review their scores and individual status to verify their performance in this stage of the competition.

Deadlines for filing appeals

The current publication represents an important milestone, but it does not yet finalize the ranking in the contest. Candidates who identify any issues subject to challenge in the preliminary results may file an appeal on September 21 and 22, 2026, strictly adhering to the guidelines and schedules established in the organizing committee's system.

Openings, salaries, and competition

The competition offers 24 immediate openings, in addition to a reserve roster, distributed among mid-level and higher-level positions with a 40-hour workweek. Initial compensation varies according to each role: for Judicial Technician, the starting salary is R$ 5,381.36, while for Judicial Analyst and Court Bailiff, compensation reaches R$ 8,829.24.

Calendar of upcoming stages

The selection schedule outlines further steps following this preliminary phase, including the final exam results and credential evaluation in October, as well as specific stages for affirmative action candidates and people with disabilities. The release of the approved candidates list is scheduled for the end of the year, on December 2, 2026.

With information from FIIBrasil, Ache Concursos, SpaceMoney.
